game_concept: A card battler set in Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge, a bridge in a blizzard: the innkeeper must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Vault: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the hold gate.
theme: Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge: a bridge in a blizzard
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Bridge, repeat each round: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the hold gate. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the vault value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about vault to power up the innkeeper and open the hold gate.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Return Vault
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Vault' (Week 6 slot 3), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Blizzard Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Blizzard Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
